name: Delegate
description: Hand work to another swarm agent — sparingly. Only for tunnel/SSH workplaces you cannot reach, an agent the user asked for, or genuinely parallel tasks. Do your own work otherwise.

function.name: delegate
function.description: Delegate a bounded task to an enabled configured agent by id or name. Available in a chat led by a single agent too: no @mention or new chat is required. Use for work owned by a remote workplace agent or when the user requests delegation, choosing a suitable enabled peer if they did not name one. For a multi-worker team use start_swarm. After success the target runs immediately and its result returns to you for synthesis.

name.description: Target agent display name (alternative to agent_id).

reason.description: Full brief: goal, workplace id/name/host, paths, constraints, prior findings. Never a one-word reason.
